## Household economics (SHED) {#sec-data-shed}

The Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (SHED) is an annual
survey of U.S. adults conducted since 2013 by the Board of Governors of the
Federal Reserve System. It measures how households assess their own finances
and the broader economy, alongside employment, income, housing, and
demographic characteristics. The course extract `shed_2025.csv` covers the
2025 wave: 12,934 respondents, drawn from a probability-based online panel
designed to be representative of the U.S. adult population.

**Resources:**

- [SHED — Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/shed.htm)
- [Public-use data and codebooks](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/shed_data.htm)

**Provenance.** The public-use 2025 microdata file was downloaded from the
Board's SHED data page. As a work of the federal government, the file is in
the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission; the
Board requests citation. The course extract keeps nine columns from the
original 380, renames them to snake_case, and changes no values. Survey
weights are not carried in the extract; course examples report unweighted
proportions, which on the extract's variables differ from weighted ones by
less than a percentage point. Respondents rate every retained item on a
forced-choice basis, so the extract has no missing values and no "don't
know" category.

### Variables {.unnumbered}

| Variable | Type | Unit / Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `case_id` | Discrete | — | Respondent identifier assigned by the survey (`shedid` in the source file). |
| `econ_conditions_country` | Categorical (ordinal) | Poor / Only fair / Good / Excellent | "In this country --- how would you rate economic conditions today?" (source item `B7_b`). |
| `employment_status` | Categorical | Not working / Working part-time / Working full-time | Panel-recorded employment status (`ppemploy`). |
| `household_income` | Categorical (ordinal) | 7 bins, Less than $10,000 to $150,000 or more | Total household income bin (`ppinc7`). |
| `age_category` | Categorical (ordinal) | 7 bins, 18--24 to 75+ | Respondent age bin (`ppagecat`). |
| `education` | Categorical (ordinal) | 4 levels | Highest educational attainment (`ppeducat`). |
| `gender` | Categorical | Male / Female | Panel-recorded gender (`ppgender`). |
| `region` | Categorical | Northeast / Midwest / South / West | Census region of residence (`ppreg4`). |
| `housing_status` | Categorical | Own with mortgage / Own free and clear / Pay rent / Neither own nor rent | Home tenure (source item `GH1`). |
